title: Director.AI
tagline: Building autonomous agentic pipelines as per user request + payment handling per agent via X-402

prizes.title: Best Use of x402 Agentic Payments on Polygon

description: The project helps orchestrate AI agents to complete complex tasks. AI agents receive payments for the work done and are gated using the x-402 protocol. The user enters a complex query and our server intelligently decides the order in which subtasks execute along with the agent picked for each subtask. The orchestrator then attempts to execute this tasks and make payments as requested by the AI agents. Post completion it returns the complete response back to user along with important details of the AI agents that were used and the payments that were made during the flow.
how_its_made: The frontend of the project is built with Next.js and we use reown to help with the wallet interactions. The orchestrator server is a node js server powered by Gemini. The AI agentic servers are Hono servers and the payments between the orchestrator and the AI agents happens in accordance with the x-402 protocol.
